title: A Transparent Fairness Evaluation Protocol for Open-Source Language Model Benchmarking on the Blockchain

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating contextual associations (intra-sentence and inter-sentence tasks) using the StereoSet dataset to compute ICAT metrics, and measuring counterfactual change rates by modifying race attributes in prompts.

Evaluating contextual associations (intra-sentence and inter-sentence tasks) using the StereoSet dataset to compute ICAT metrics, and measuring counterfactual change rates by modifying gender attributes in prompts.
Evaluating contextual associations (intra-sentence and inter-sentence tasks) using the StereoSet dataset to compute ICAT metrics for religious stereotypes.
Evaluating contextual associations (intra-sentence and inter-sentence tasks) using the StereoSet dataset to compute ICAT metrics for professional stereotypes.

Using the PISA dataset to evaluate educational fairness by predicting student academic performance based on demographic and socioeconomic background variables, assessing outcomes using Statistical Parity Difference, Equal Opportunity Difference, Average Odds Difference, and Disparate Impact Ratio.
Using the Kaleidoscope benchmark to evaluate fairness and consistency across languages (English, Spanish, and Portuguese) by measuring accuracy and format error rates on parallel prompts.
